resource_contract.provider_location: new <root_quota>/provider under the same 2GiB physical quota
resource_contract.provider_measurement: Metadata sampled with per-process reuse interval <=1s; freshly sampled on entry and before launch/answer/detach effects. This sampled sub-budget is not a separate physical provider sandbox.

native_signal_policy: Record GUI quit intent before CmdQ. Exact app may receive SIGTERM only on admitted deadline/resource/observer failure and only if birth/UID/path still match. Such a path cannot pass normal-close gate. Unconfirmed returned_candidate is never signal authority.

prior_preparation.new_case_reason: Root diagnosed provider metadata recursion on every download chunk. New independent source/provider layout closes the probe overhead without extending the old deadline or replaying an app/effect.

provider_policy.fresh_provider: Create only root_quota/provider mode0700 immediately after confirmed mount, before resource anchor. Signed QA config pins that path. No old provider access, contents or metadata.
provider_policy.owner_account_action: Owner completes official Codex/ChatGPT login from this new app if account is disconnected; no credentials or codes in chat. No OS notification/TCC prompt in this case.

owner_account_actions_required: Complete official Codex with ChatGPT login from the visible new QA app only if disconnected; passwords/account grants are owner-only.
